# ARA Diagnostic Imaging

> > ARA Diagnostic Imaging is Central Texas's leading radiology practice offering advanced diagnostic imaging, interventional radiology, and molecular imaging services across the Austin area.

ARA provides comprehensive medical imaging services including MRI, PET/CT, nuclear medicine, and minimally invasive interventional procedures like PAE, UFE, and EVLT. The practice uses InteleConnect PACS for provider access and operates specialized centers including the Mueller Children's Center for pediatric radiology.

## Diagnostic Imaging Services

- [Molecular Radiology | Diagnostic Imaging Nuclear Medicine](https://www.ausrad.com/exams-services/nuclear-medicine): Nuclear medicine & molecular radiology services using radiopharmaceuticals
- [MRI Angiography (MRA)](https://www.ausrad.com/exams-services/magnetic-resonance-imaging/mri-angiography-mra): MRA vascular imaging using MRI to detect blood vessel abnormalities
- [Stereotactic Breast Biopsy](https://www.ausrad.com/exams-services/breast-imaging/stereotactic-breast-biopsy): Mammography-guided stereotactic breast biopsy procedure overview

## Interventional Radiology Procedures

- [Prostate Artery Embolization: A Non-Invasive Treatment for BPH](https://www.ausrad.com/video/prostate-artery-embolization-a-non-invasive-treatment-for-bph): Dr. Connie Hsu on PAE as minimally invasive BPH treatment option
- [Embolización de la Arteria Prostática (PAE)](https://www.ausrad.com/es/examenes-y-servicios/radiologia-intervencionista/pae): Prostate artery embolization for enlarged prostate/BPH (Spanish)
- [Dr. Hsu on Uterine Fibroid Embolization](https://www.ausrad.com/video/dr-connie-hsu-discusses-aras-uterine-fibroid-embolization-procedure): Dr. Connie Hsu explains UFE as minimally invasive fibroid treatment option
- [Taking Care of Your Nephrostomy Drain](https://www.ausrad.com/video/taking-care-of-your-nephrostomy-drain): Patient education on nephrostomy drainage system care & maintenance
